import numpy as np

def kl_divergence(p, q):
    p_clipped = np.clip(p, 1e-15, 1)
    q_clipped = np.clip(q, 1e-15, 1)
    p_clipped = p_clipped / np.sum(p_clipped)
    q_clipped = q_clipped / np.sum(q_clipped)
    kl = np.sum(p_clipped * np.log(p_clipped / q_clipped))
    return kl

def js_divergence(p, q):
    m = 0.5 * (p + q)
    js = 0.5 * kl_divergence(p, m) + 0.5 * kl_divergence(q, m)
    return js

p = np.array([0.5, 0.3, 0.2])
q = np.array([0.4, 0.3, 0.3])
print(f"KL(P||Q): {kl_divergence(p, q):.4f}")
print(f"KL(Q||P): {kl_divergence(q, p):.4f}")
print(f"JS(P||Q): {js_divergence(p, q):.4f}")
